title: ASAN leak - strings in the tsi peer

milestone.title: Public Repository
milestone.description: Make our repository open to the world

body:
To reproduce:

``` c
make CONFIG=asan  chttp2_simple_ssl_fullstack_disappearing_server_test
ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1 bins/asan/chttp2_simple_ssl_fullstack_disappearing_server_test
```
